title: Frontmatter description still sells extension ideation
reality: v2.3.4 removed the extension feature completely — all extension CSS/browser/server execution, Settings surface, client hooks, shared contract, API routes, and authoring guides are gone; retained records are erased at startup. Themes (Settings > Addons) survive.
fix: In the YAML description, drop 'extensions' from the ideation list and change the trigger phrase 'custom tools / extensions / webhooks' accordingly. Keep 'extensions' only as a trigger word with the skill answering that the feature was removed in 2.3.4.

title: Ideation mode bullet lists 'an extension' as buildable
reality: Extensions no longer exist as of v2.3.4; buildable user-side surfaces are characters, lorebooks, custom tools, agents (incl. downloadable agent packages), themes, regex scripts.
fix: Change '(a character, a lorebook, a custom tool, an agent, an extension)' to '(a character, a lorebook, a custom tool, an agent, a theme)'.

title: Mode-detection text: 'building extensions, themes, custom CSS/JS'
reality: v2.3.4 removed extensions and all custom CSS/JS execution paths. Themes remain the only user-side UI customization; third-party functionality goes through downloadable agent packages, including disabled-by-default custom GitHub agent repositories (#3861).
fix: Rewrite 'including building extensions, themes, custom CSS/JS, lorebooks, or characters' to 'including building themes, custom agents, lorebooks, or characters'.

title: 'Extensions and themes are NOT contribution work' callout
reality: The extension feature (and the user extensions/ folder execution path) was removed in v2.3.4. 'I want to build an extension that does X' can no longer be answered with extension guidance.
fix: Rewrite the callout around themes only. Add: 'Extensions were REMOVED in v2.3.4 — if a user asks to build one, tell them the feature no longer exists (startup permanently erases retained extension records and extension-storage:* settings) and redirect to themes (visual), custom tools/agents (functionality), or an engine PR (UI changes).'

title: Reference table routes UI work to references/extensions.md
reality: Upstream removed the extension feature and its authoring guides in v2.3.4; there is no client extension API anymore. Themes and native Settings > Appearance are the surviving UI-customization surfaces.
fix: Replace the extensions.md table row with a themes/appearance + 'why extensions no longer exist' row still pointing at the (tombstoned) extensions.md; DOM injection/custom JS is no longer possible without an engine PR.

title: Decision-guide table row includes 'extension' as an option
reality: Extensions are no longer a pickable architecture surface as of v2.3.4.
fix: Change 'picking between prompt-stuffing, lorebook, tool call, extension, custom agent' to '...tool call, theme, custom agent'.

title: Mode A intro lists 'extension, theme, custom CSS/JS' as deliverables
reality: Extensions and custom CSS/JS execution were removed in v2.3.4; themes survive.
fix: Change 'custom tool, agent, **extension, theme, custom CSS/JS**' to 'custom tool, agent, **theme**'.

title: Decision hierarchy step 7: 'Client extension (CSS + JS with the marinara API)'
reality: v2.3.4 deleted the client extension surface entirely. UI appearance changes go through native Settings > Appearance and custom themes (Settings > Addons); functional UI changes require a capability package or an engine contribution.
fix: Rewrite step 7: look-and-feel → native Appearance settings or a custom theme; new UI functionality → no user-side path as of 2.3.4 (extensions removed) — capability package or engine PR (Mode B).

title: Limits list: 'without writing extensions' vector-DB caveat
reality: With extensions removed in v2.3.4, plugging in an external vector DB is only possible via webhook tools + your own backend, or by forking the engine.
fix: Change 'you can't plug in Pinecone/Weaviate without writing extensions' to '...except via webhook tools to your own backend (or forking)'.

title: Limits list: 'CSS/JS extensions still have no marketplace' distribution bullet
reality: CSS/JS extensions no longer exist at all in v2.3.4. The second (non-official) distribution surface is now disabled-by-default custom GitHub agent repositories in Agents Manager (#3861): manual preview/apply, explicit trust confirmation, stable sync identity, bounded SSRF-safe archive validation.
fix: Replace the extension half of the bullet with the two agent-distribution lanes (official catalog + custom GitHub repos #3861); state CSS/JS extensions were removed entirely.

title: Version marker '2.3.3 at the last reference sync'
reality: Upstream stable is v2.3.4 (2026-07-23).
fix: Change to '(2.3.4 at the last reference sync)'; sweep any other 2.3.3 markers after edits.

title: Section 0 exemption list still exempts 'Extensions (extensions/ folder)'
reality: The extensions/ folder execution path and the entire feature were removed in v2.3.4.
fix: Delete the Extensions exemption bullet; keep the themes bullet but drop 'custom CSS / custom JS'. Optionally: re-adding anything extension-like IS core engine work needing maintainer sign-off.

title: Pre-submission checklist exemption mentions extensions and custom CSS/JS
reality: Extensions/custom JS removed in v2.3.4; only themes and user-side assets remain PR-free.
fix: Change 'Extensions, themes, custom CSS/JS, and anything the user is keeping on their own install' to 'Themes and anything the user is keeping on their own install (cards, lorebooks, custom tools)'.

reality: v2.3.4 ships Android versionName 2.3.4 with versionCode 39; the next shipped APK must exceed 39.
fix: Update the baseline: versionCode is 39 at v2.3.4 (34/35/37/38 at 2.3.0-2.3.3).

title: No mention of custom GitHub agent repositories in agents guidance
reality: v2.3.4 added disabled-by-default custom GitHub agent repositories to Agents Manager (#3861) with manual preview/apply, explicit trust confirmation, stable sync identity, and SSRF-safe archive validation — the sanctioned third-party agent-distribution path. Also #3953: imported agent files no longer bundle function definitions or self-grant tools; tools must be attached manually after import.
fix: In the agents reference-table row and/or decision-hierarchy step 5, add the custom GitHub repositories path (#3861) and the import hardening note (#3953).

title: Q6 'Client extension' answer is a removed feature
reality: v2.3.4 removed the entire client extension surface: CustomThemeInjector JS loading, the scoped marinara API, the Settings surface, client hooks, shared contract, and API routes. Themes (server-synced custom themes, Settings > Addons, /api/themes) and native Settings > Appearance survive. Mari's extension-authoring instructions were removed (she can still generate themes).
fix: Rewrite Q6 entirely: appearance/look-and-feel → native Settings > Appearance or a custom theme; new UI functionality (buttons, panels, widgets, DOM injection) → no user-side path as of 2.3.4 — route to a downloadable capability package, a custom GitHub agent repository (#3861), or an engine PR. Delete the marinara-API bullet list, the no-longer-achievable Fits examples, the 'Mari can generate extensions' parenthetical, and the extensions.md authoring pointer.

title: 'Immersive RP character' stack recommends 'extension (custom HUD)'
reality: Extensions removed in v2.3.4; a custom HUD via user extension is impossible. The native Tracker Panel covers the HUD use case.
fix: Change '+ optional **extension** (custom HUD)' to '+ the native Tracker Panel for on-screen state'.

title: Q9 routes UI changes 'to an extension'
reality: Extensions removed in v2.3.4; UI changes are themes (visual) or engine contribution (functional).
fix: Change the Q9 'that's an extension' cross-references to themes / engine change.

title: Question-to-ask #6 cites 'extensions' as a polish surface
reality: Extensions removed in v2.3.4.
fix: Change '(extensions, tool confirmation flows)' to '(themes, tool confirmation flows)'.
